full_query: How am I supposed to put ointment on my nipple if it's pierced

shared_context.topic: applying ointment to a pierced nipple

sentences: To apply ointment to a pierced nipple, follow these steps
Wash your hands thoroughly before touching the area to prevent infection
Clean the pierced area gently with saline solution or a mild, fragrance-free soap and water
Avoid using alcohol or hydrogen peroxide as they can be too harsh
Dry the area with a clean, soft towel or let it air dry completely
Remove the jewelry if possible and if advised by your healthcare provider
This allows for better access to the area and ensures the ointment can be applied directly to the skin
Apply a small amount of ointment directly to the pierced area
Use a clean cotton swab or your fingertip to spread the ointment evenly
Reinsert the jewelry if it was removed, ensuring it is clean before doing so
Repeat the application as directed by your healthcare provider, typically 2-3 times a day
If you experience any signs of infection, such as increased redness, swelling, pain, or discharge, contact your healthcare provider promptly
